usedFor.monster: traits and actions from the dataset; header lines, XP, proficiency bonus and legendary-action text from the PDF
usedFor.equipment: PDF tables and entries (the dataset's descriptions for equipment are not SRD text)
usedFor.rule: text from the dataset where it equals the PDF word for word, PDF text otherwise; headings, ids, page ranges, sidebars and every PDF-only record come from the PDF

repairs: Awakened Tree: "Slam" text taken from the PDF (dataset numbers differ)
Axe Beak: "Beak" text taken from the PDF (dataset numbers differ)
Black Pudding: feature "Parry" renamed to "Split" (dataset name absent from the PDF block)
rule: tables whose header spans two body columns (Cover) take their column names from the printed header text split by hand
rule: Travel Pace column names join the spanning header ("Distance Traveled Per") with the column header
rule: hyphenated line breaks are rejoined; a paragraph split by a sidebar or table is rejoined
rule: sidebar boxes become child records of the heading they sit under
rule: numbered steps keep the printed "N:" prefix (D20 Tests steps print as 4, 5 and 6)
absentTopics: contests and opposed checks: the SRD 5.2.1 PDF text prints no contest or opposed-check rule (searched pages 1-364 for "contest" and "opposed")

ruleHeadingCheck.method: The heading index (provenance/srd-5.2.1-index.json kinds.rule) was compared with the PDF contents page: all 38 Playing the Game entries match by title and page. Sixteen records were then read against their PDF pages with pdftotext: heading, opening words, table row counts and page ranges all agree.
